cards.name: Magical Girl Explosion!

coverage_override.reason: Fresh semantic segmentation found 4 individual printed procedure/effect records. Conjunctions, choices, dependent 'then/and if you do' steps, and their HOPT/use-cap text are kept with the single Lua effect that resolves them; separately functioning procedures, continuous rules, and activated/triggered effects are separate records.

effects.printed_clause: (This card is always treated as a "Charmelia" card.)
effects.lua_implementation: The current CCG database row stores both the card's own setcode and Charmelia setcode 0x12b1 (hex blob D2EBB112); listed_series also exposes Charmelia to script tooling.

official_references.matched_structure: Official always-treated-as naming/archetype classification is database/list metadata rather than an activated Lua effect.

effects.printed_clause: If the opponent controls more cards, they cannot respond to this card's effect activations.
effects.lua_implementation: Each activated effect calls protect_chain during target setup; if the opponent's on-field count exceeds the controller's, SetChainLimit permits only the controller to add the next chain link.

official_references.matched_structure: Sets a chain limit during activation targeting so the opponent cannot respond.

effects.printed_clause: Once per turn during either Main Phase: Tribute a hand/face-up-field "Charmelia" monster; non-target-select an opponent monster, negate it, and if successful banish it face-down.
effects.lua_implementation: A Main-Phase Quick Effect releases one eligible hand/MZONE monster as cost, non-target-selects a negatable opposing monster at resolution, registers disable effects, then removes it face-down without a sequential break; id count limit applies.

official_references.matched_structure: Banishes a monster and applies effect negation to the selected card.
Cost followed by negation and a dependent removal/destruction operation.

effects.printed_clause: If the opponent controls an Extra-Deck-Summoned monster: Special Summon a "Charmelia" Ritual from hand/Deck/GY ignoring conditions, treated as a Ritual Summon; HOPT.
effects.lua_implementation: The condition now recognizes every opponent monster whose Summon location was the Extra Deck, including a face-down one, matching Dogmatika Ecclesia. The filter and operation use nocheck=true,nolimit=true to ignore Summoning Conditions, summon with SUMMON_TYPE_RITUAL, and CompleteProcedure.

official_references.matched_structure: Official Extra-Deck-summoned-monster condition checks IsSummonLocation without requiring face-up.
Ignoring Summoning conditions uses IsCanBeSpecialSummoned/Duel.SpecialSummon with nocheck=true.
Special Summon treated as a Ritual Summon through SUMMON_TYPE_RITUAL and CompleteProcedure.

effects.issue: Confirmed and corrected: the old face-up filter excluded face-down Extra-Deck-Summoned monsters, and nocheck=false did not implement the explicit 'ignoring its Summoning Conditions' instruction.

cards.reconciliation_note: All batch_8c findings for this card were re-evaluated against current Lua and the cited official Omega references. Confirmed defects are patched; retained CUSTOM_GAP records explain the remaining engine/source limit.
